title: Acks with a bitfield
hints: Shifting a 32-bit value by 32 or more is undefined behaviour in C++. Handle jumps above 32 by clearing the bits, and do the shift itself in 64 bits so a jump of exactly 32 still works.
In `onAck`, loop from bit 31 down to bit 0 and then the ack itself: that visits the numbers oldest first, which is the order to return them in.
